facts.fact: Minister Segokgo, reported by BOPA, cites the 2022 census as the source of Botswana's population figure, so a census was counted in 2022.
Minister Segokgo says the government's village connectivity project, aimed at over 500 villages, had in its first phase connected 1,138 public facilities across 144 villages.

BWA.note: The document describes SmartBots as a strategy for the economy and society being rolled out, but states no adoption, body, budget, period, plan or reporting.
The document says nothing on criticism, cuts or punishment of speech.
It gives 609 schools connected under a connectivity project, not the share of secondary schools with internet, and nothing on a compulsory curriculum.
